ModMetaData.name: 沃芬工作优先级初始化修复 / Wolfein Work Priorities Init Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复 Wolfein Race 在 RimWorld 1.7 生成袭击者时的红字：外骨骼 Hediff 的 CompPostPostAdd 会读取尚未初始化的 Pawn_WorkSettings，触发 “Sale did not have work settings initialized.” 并提前初始化工作优先级。本补丁在该阶段跳过优先级保存/恢复，把初始化留给原版流程；已初始化 pawn 的行为完全不变。
Fixes the RimWorld 1.7 red error when Wolfein raiders spawn with heavy gear augmentations. The hediff comp read Pawn_WorkSettings before vanilla initialized it, logging "did not have work settings initialized" and initializing priorities mid-generation. The patch skips priority bookkeeping only while work settings are uninitialized; behavior for initialized pawns is unchanged.
